scenario_prompt: Analyze these Windows event logs for signs of Kerberos-based host enumeration or Active Directory reconnaissance. Identify the account performing the enumeration, the pattern of service ticket requests, and the network source. Use only evidence present in the data.

expected_findings.indicator: Event ID 4769: High volume of Kerberos TGS requests for host enumeration
expected_findings.explanation: A large number of Kerberos service ticket (TGS) requests targeting different hosts indicates systematic enumeration of Active Directory computer objects, consistent with tools like BloodHound/SharpHound.
The admmig account in the OFFSEC.LAN domain was used to request service tickets for multiple hosts, indicating AD reconnaissance with a compromised privileged account.
All Kerberos TGS requests originated from the IPv4-mapped IPv6 address ::ffff:10.23.23.9, identifying the host running the enumeration tool.

notes: Medium case: all events are 4769 (Kerberos TGS requests), but analyst must recognize the enumeration pattern - rapid, systematic TGS requests to many different service principal names from a single source. Requires understanding Kerberos authentication flows and AD reconnaissance techniques.
